architecture: Multi-head R3D-18 (shared backbone, independent sigmoid heads)
known_findings: SCVD clip duration alone predicts class with 81.7% accuracy (undocumented confound, corrected via fixed-frame sampling)
Hard-rule weapon+violence fusion cascades DEGRADE accuracy (tested 3x with different weapon detectors) — motivated multi-head redesign

Weapon head performance (0.911 AUC) derives from learned contextual/motion features, not object localization — a separate YOLOv8 detector is used for visual bounding-box overlay only, not for the alert decision
deployment_principle: All model outputs require human verification before any alert is actioned
